description: Look up one AI crawler or bot by its exact user-agent token, for example GPTBot or Claude-User. Returns the operator, what the agent is for (training, search indexing, or user-triggered fetching), whether it honors robots.txt, and the operator's own documentation. Matching is case-insensitive and exact: GPT does not match GPTBot.

token.description: The exact user-agent token only, for example 'GPTBot' or 'Claude-User'. Not a full user-agent string, not a URL.

name: lookup_crawler

crawler.description: The registry record for the token.

title: Look up an AI crawler by user-agent token
